_comment: WC2026 QUARTER-FINAL (QF98: winner of Portugal-Spain vs winner of USA-Belgium). KNOCKOUT: no draw -- level after 90' -> extra time -> penalties, so the deliverable is who ADVANCES. Winner meets France (who beat Morocco 2-0) in the semi-finals (M101). Routes: Spain WON Group H and has conceded ZERO in the ENTIRE tournament -- FIVE straight clean sheets (0-0 Cape Verde, 4-0 Saudi, 1-0 Uruguay, 3-0 Austria R32, 1-0 Portugal R16 with a late winner; rating 94). The best defence in the tournament plus a devastating attack when the game opens. Belgium WON Group G and arrives with a FIRING attack (3-2 aet Senegal from 2-0 down, 4-1 rout of co-host USA; rating 86) BUT: they CONCEDE in almost every game (2 vs Senegal, 1 vs USA, 1 vs Egypt) and are BLUNT vs organized sides (1-1 Egypt, 0-0 Iran) -- and Spain is THE most organized side left. Class gap ~8 (94 vs 86) -> Spain the clear favourite, and the STYLE matchup compounds it: Spain's airtight block frustrates a Belgium that struggles vs organization, while Spain's clinical attack punishes a leaky Belgian defence. BTTS RULE: Spain a clear favourite; Belgium's attack is REAL and in form (not zeroed -- lambda 0.90, they scored 3+ in three of five games) but faces the tournament's best defence -> mild lean BTTS-No (51.5%), Spain clean sheet 40.7%. Draw/ET tail respected (ET 26.7%, pens 13.8%) -- Belgium survived an ET epic vs Senegal and is tournament-tough. Spain to a controlled win most likely (1-0/2-0/2-1); Belgium's equity is scoring first / dragging it deep. Home = Spain (nominal; neutral venue). Cards not modelled (referee TBD).
